description: List every rated power market with its PGIQ tier (1 Prime to 5 Largely closed), 0-100 PGIQ Rating, Fundamentals score and outlook, as of the rating vintage (as_of). No cost fields; use pgiq_rating or pgiq_screen for cost. Start here to discover market ids. Responses from API schema 1.1 onward also carry figures.{field} = {value, unit, as_of (ISO date or month), source, method, confidence, stable_id, report_url}: when present, quote the unit and as_of from it, and a null value there carries figures.{field}.absence -- insufficient_evidence (not enough evidence), structurally_unavailable (does not exist there, e.g. no wholesale market), not_collected (exists, not held) or withheld (paid) -- with reason_text; report which one. Older responses have no figures object: take the unit from the field name or field_provenance and the date from as_of. Either way, never report an absent value as zero; say it is not held.
name: pgiq_markets
